conventions.birthYear: Every card's birth year is corroborated by at least one source better than a fan-wiki/'birthday aggregator' site (FamousBirthdays, IMDb-only bios, etc.) - most commonly a Wikipedia article that in turn cites real journalism, a self-disclosure by the creator themselves (a video, tweet or Instagram post), or a reputable news outlet. Several candidate creators researched for this deck were excluded entirely because no such source could be found for their age (see the WBS slice's Delivered notes for the full list). Where only the birth year (not exact date) is corroborated, only the year is stored.
conventions.channelStartYear: The year the creator began actively posting under their current channel identity, not necessarily when a YouTube account was first registered (several creators' accounts predate their content by years, or migrated from an earlier channel name/identity). Several of these dates are lower-confidence than birthYear, since 'channel joined' dates are less consistently reported than birth dates; flagged per card where confidence is lower.
conventions.subscribers: A live, constantly-changing figure. Every card's value is anchored to a specific 'as of' date (late July/early August 2026) recorded in that card's _sources - re-verify before relying on these for anything beyond this deck's gameplay.
conventions.videos: Total upload count on the creator's main channel only, excluding secondary/spin-off channels the same creator may also run. Third-party trackers frequently disagree by small margins on this figure; a middle estimate is used where sources conflict, flagged per card.
conventions.totalViews: Lifetime view count on the creator's main channel only. This metric replaced an originally-planned 'Height' stat: reliable, cited height data exists for essentially none of these creators (fan-wiki guesses were the only source found for all but two), which conflicts with this deck's sourcing rule, so Total Views was used instead as a metric with genuinely available, cited data for the whole roster.
conventions.roster: This deck originally targeted a different 30-name roster more closely matching the initial brief, but approximately a dozen candidates were swapped out during research because no source better than a fan-wiki/content-farm site could be found for their age, which this deck's sourcing rule treats as disqualifying. See the WBS slice's Delivered section for the full substitution history.
